name: game-piano-protagonist
description: Falling-notes piano practice for the Game Room. Pick a chord lesson or a public-domain tune and loop it: the notes drop toward a keyboard on screen and you play along on a MIDI keyboard, on the keyboard linked to her machine, or on the computer's keys. Hear the song or not, score each pass or not.
author: Krem & Claude

games.title: Piano Protagonist
games.desc: We have Guitar Hero at home. Pick a song, loop it, play along on the keys. Ten chords, a shelf of old tunes, three difficulties, and a score only if you ask for one.
facts: Three ways to play: a MIDI keyboard in this browser, the keyboard linked to the machine she runs on, or the computer's own keys laid out like a piano with middle C under G
One mode: the song loops with a rest between passes until you stop it, and the keys are live the whole time
The speaker button plays the song as it scrolls or leaves the bars silent; slow it to ¼, ½ or ¾ speed
Scoring is optional and quiet: a number in the corner after each pass (pitch × timing × hold × streak), sparks for a catch, nothing for a miss
Nothing is kept and she takes no part yet. Paste your own tunes in the game's settings: name | bpm | notation, one per line
